spec_proposal: P12 canonical specification proposal — Human approved 2026-09-21; incorporated into CANONICAL_SPEC.md 1.1 and re-frozen
p12_candidates: P12-CAND-002 Figure Page-Fit / Figure Size Policy
new_features: Figure page-fit sizing derived from the effective section content box (aspect-ratio preserving, never upscaling, page-fit mandatory, minimum-width diagnostic, real rendered-figure overflow measurement)
Conservative two-column whitespace-aligned simple-table recognition (ruler line required, shared column anchor, plain-text cells, config-gated via simple_tables.enabled)
behaviour_corrections: An empty heading is no longer replaced by the literal placeholder "Heading" and no longer produces a synthetic TOC entry (WARN + DROP)
canonical_semantic_changes: P12-CAND-001 adds a previously undefined Markdown construct (whitespace-aligned simple tables) and P12-CAND-003 defines previously undefined empty-heading behaviour; both are additive/approved evolution, not changes to existing defined semantics
architecture_changes: none (no pipeline stage, ownership boundary, LayoutPlan contract or dependency-direction change)
known_limitations: Simple-table recognition is intentionally conservative: 2 columns, plain-text cells, top-level paragraphs, ruler line required; a rejected block stays a paragraph and emits no diagnostic
Final physical Word pagination remains Word-owned; the converter does not promise an exact page number or deterministic final pagination
Figure minimum-width behaviour is bounded by the approved policy: a page-fit scaling that lands below the theme floor is delivered fitted and reported as a warning
Extremely wide figures (very small rendered height) are not addressed by the figure size policy
